name: native-live-docx-preview-debug
description: 独立诊断真实 OOXML DOCX 预览的段落与 run 样式。沿用原生文件树和 docx-preview 流程，把只读 pageProbe 放在严格语义断言之前；probe 只记录 marker 子树内有限的 p/span/strong/b 计算样式、class、样式表可读性和页面几何，不读取正文或凭据，不注入样式，不调用模型或 inline invoke。

files.evidence.txt: DOCX 原生预览样式诊断隔离项目基线

coverage.evidence: 严格断言前的受限 pageProbe，记录每个 style 的 sheet/nonce/cssRules 状态和 marker 子树 p/span/strong/b 的计算样式
真实 docx-render-styles 容器中的样式表有效，不能由 probe 注入或以正文文本代替

styleRequirements: 所有 style.sheet 可读取且 nonce 非空
至少存在 custom 与 generated 两类 style，generated cssRules 总数大于 0
至少一个渲染页面 getBoundingClientRect 的宽高大于 0
严格断言仍要求夹具 Heading1 的蓝色、粗体与约 18.67px computed style
docxValidator.pageProbe: 只记录布尔值、样式表数量/规则数量、marker 子树有限节点的 tag/class/计算样式和页面几何，不写入正文内容

knownGaps: 本计划只诊断 Tauri renderer 内真实 docx-preview；不宣称系统 Word 或 Office 桌面应用打开成功。
probe 不修改 DOM/CSS，不读取 provider、路径或正文，不将可见文本存在当作样式通过。

steps.expression: (() => { const root=document.querySelector('[data-testid="preview-pane"] [data-docx-render-root]'); const body=root?.querySelector('[data-docx-render-body]'); const styles=[...root?.querySelectorAll('[data-docx-render-styles] style') ?? []]; const generated=styles.filter(style => !style.hasAttribute('data-docx-page-surface-style')); const allReadable=styles.length >= 2 && styles.every(style => { try { return !!style.sheet && style.nonce.trim().length > 0; } catch { return false; } }); const generatedRules=generated.reduce((total, style) => { try { return total + (style.sheet?.cssRules?.length ?? 0); } catch { return total; } }, 0); const pages=[...body?.querySelectorAll('section, .docx') ?? []]; const marker=root?.textContent?.includes('NATIVE_DOCX_FIXTURE_43') === true; return !!root && !!body && marker && allReadable && generated.length > 0 && generatedRules > 0 && pages.some(page => { const rect=page.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0; }); })()

steps.name: native-docx-semantic-debug-probe
steps.expression: (() => { const preview=document.querySelector('[data-testid="preview-pane"]'); const root=preview?.querySelector('[data-docx-render-root]'); const styles=[...root?.querySelectorAll('[data-docx-render-styles] style') ?? []]; const stylesheets=styles.map((style,index) => { let cssRules=0; let readable=false; let hasNonce=false; try { cssRules=style.sheet?.cssRules?.length ?? 0; readable=!!style.sheet; hasNonce=style.nonce.trim().length > 0; } catch {} return { index, readable, cssRules, hasNonce, customPageSurface:style.hasAttribute('data-docx-page-surface-style') }; }); const generatedRuleCount=stylesheets.filter(style => !style.customPageSurface).reduce((total, style) => total + style.cssRules, 0); const body=root?.querySelector('[data-docx-render-body]'); const pages=[...body?.querySelectorAll('section, .docx') ?? []].map(page => { const rect=page.getBoundingClientRect(); return { width:Math.round(rect.width), height:Math.round(rect.height), display:getComputedStyle(page).display }; }).filter(page => page.width > 0 && page.height > 0); const markerNode=[...body?.querySelectorAll('*') ?? []].find(node => [...node.childNodes].some(child => child.nodeType === 3 && child.nodeValue?.includes('NATIVE_DOCX_FIXTURE_43'))); const heading=[...body?.querySelectorAll('p,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,span,strong,b') ?? []].find(node => node.textContent?.includes('真实 DOCX 预览样式验收')); const semanticRoot=heading ?? markerNode; const leafNodes=[semanticRoot, ...semanticRoot?.querySelectorAll('p,span,strong,b') ?? []].filter((node,index,nodes) => node && nodes.indexOf(node) === index).slice(0,16); const leafStyles=leafNodes.map(node => { const computed=getComputedStyle(node); return { tag:node.tagName.toLowerCase(), className:String(node.className ?? '').slice(0,160), isHeadingCandidate:node===heading, isMarkerNode:node===markerNode, computed:{ color:computed.color, fontWeight:computed.fontWeight, fontSize:computed.fontSize, display:computed.display } }; }); return { marker:Boolean(root?.textContent?.includes('NATIVE_DOCX_FIXTURE_43')), headingFound:Boolean(heading), markerNodeFound:Boolean(markerNode), stylesheets, generatedRuleCount, pages, leafStyles }; })()
steps.description: 严格断言前只读采集 marker 子树有限 p/span/strong/b 的 class、color、fontWeight、fontSize、display，以及每个样式表的 sheet/nonce/cssRules 状态

steps.expression: (() => { const root=document.querySelector('[data-testid="preview-pane"] [data-docx-render-root]'); const body=root?.querySelector('[data-docx-render-body]'); const styles=[...root?.querySelectorAll('[data-docx-render-styles] style') ?? []]; const generated=styles.filter(style => !style.hasAttribute('data-docx-page-surface-style')); const allReadable=styles.length >= 2 && styles.every(style => { try { return !!style.sheet && style.nonce.trim().length > 0; } catch { return false; } }); const generatedRules=generated.reduce((total, style) => { try { return total + (style.sheet?.cssRules?.length ?? 0); } catch { return total; } }, 0); const heading=[...body?.querySelectorAll('p') ?? []].find(element => element.textContent?.includes('真实 DOCX 预览样式验收')); const computed=heading ? getComputedStyle(heading) : null; const size=Number.parseFloat(computed?.fontSize ?? '0'); const blue=(computed?.color ?? '').replace(/\s/g, '').toLowerCase() === 'rgb(31,78,121)'; const bold=Number.parseInt(computed?.fontWeight ?? '0', 10) >= 700; const headingStyle=!!heading && !!computed && computed.display !== 'none' && blue && bold && Math.abs(size - 18.6667) < 1; return !!root && !!body && root.textContent?.includes('NATIVE_DOCX_FIXTURE_43') && allReadable && generated.length > 0 && generatedRules > 0 && headingStyle; })()
